seo.title: Contact | Tender of the Soul
seo.description: Contact Tender of the Soul to schedule a discovery call for online or in-person Hakomi sessions on Kauaʻi.

hero.title: You can start without having all the words.
hero.introduction: Reach out to schedule a complimentary discovery call. We can talk about what brings you here and whether working together feels like a good fit.

introduction.heading: A simple first step.
introduction.body: The form is not a commitment to begin sessions. Elana will respond with options for a brief conversation where you can ask questions and get a sense of the work.

details.label: Location
details.value: Kauaʻi, Hawaiʻi · online and in person

urgentNotice.heading: Please do not use this form for urgent support.
urgentNotice.body: Tender of the Soul does not provide crisis services. If you are in immediate danger, contact local emergency services or an appropriate crisis resource in your area.

form.meetingLegend: How would you prefer to meet?
form.messageLabel: What would you like Elana to know?
form.messageGuidance: Please avoid including highly sensitive medical information.
form.consentLabel: I understand this form is not monitored for urgent or crisis support.
